imas-ambix:local-lane-admission-control section 18), read at its base
957eb3c392627508b7d0879feab007af38de5d7c and head
adbd4df75d2906ba35892ac2f038fc618fc69464. I read the landed router diff and the
added test file, the plan's landing and repair records with the cumulative
evidence anchor, the target's manifest and its gate, ruff, hash and
negative-control logs, and I re-ran the single test the gate names at the
reviewed head.

VERDICT goal: the goal is to make the router cut every in-flight generation
relay when the gate file declares a cut pause; the gate file gains cut and
cut_form beside paused (imas_ambix/agent/router.py:384-386, validated against
GATE_CUT_FORMS at :68), every admitted relay arms a watcher that re-reads the
gate file (:1752-1753) and the cut ends the relay in the form the client
retries (:1826 writes the error frame, the close form returns without a
terminal chunk), the upstream request is cancelled and the relay recorded
aborted, and the repair extends the same cut to a relay still waiting on the
upstream response itself (:1773), answered whole with 529 overloaded_error and
Retry-After (:1670).
VERDICT done_when: the measure is the declared gate plus the cut behaviours it
asserts; the run directory's gate.log records 56 passed in 20.74s with per-file
counts 17 gate / 5 admission / 6 cut / 28 receipts, so the three declared gate
files hold 28 of them at 0 failures, and ruff.log reads All checks passed; each
done-when behaviour has its case -- the close form with cut_form absent and
explicit (tests/test_agent_router_cut.py:208), the overloaded_error frame before
the terminal chunk (:250), hold-then-resume order (:288), a cut already in the
file honoured by a fresh router (:327), a pause without a cut still draining
(:367), and the non-streaming cut inside 10 s answered 529 with
overloaded_error and Retry-After (:393, :436-439); I re-ran the
named test at the reviewed head and it passed 1/1 in 4.23 s (review-gate.log,
my run directory).
VERDICT write_paths: the declared fence is five paths and the diff
957eb3c3..adbd4df7 touches exactly those -- imas_ambix/agent/router.py,
tests/test_agent_router_cut.py, docs/plans/local-lane-admission-control.html,
docs/evidence/archive/local-lane-admission-control-landed.html and
docs/figures/local-lane-admission-control/pause-cut-forms.svg -- with the only
deletions in the docs being the plan-version meta line (76 to 77) and the
plan-verifies meta rewrite that gains the new anchor; the reviewed worktree is
clean at adbd4df7 and my own re-run of the named test wrote nothing outside the
target tree's gitignored bytecode caches, my run directory and node-local /tmp.

/home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20260925T135405243335-s18-router-cut/manifest.md;
it names the four commits, the exact gate command with its 56 passed in 20.74s
and clean Ruff, the measurement module and cwds, the declared negative-control
string as its red log's first line with the byte-identical restore and its two
hash files and the reason the committed blob differs by one blank line, plus

and reckon crew check-manifest on this run reports ok true with no findings.

watcher and both forms with the first five tests, 581474e8 records the landing
in the plan and the cumulative anchor with the figure, d2893cb3 adds the
